pullRequest.title: scheduler: replace pkg/apis/core/validation dependency with local const
pullRequest.body:
pkg/scheduler only uses k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/apis/core/validation for NoteLengthLimit, for which a local copy remains safe even if stale.

Part of removal of k/k imports in pkg/scheduler to support move to staging.

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

Removes the `k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/apis/core/validation` dependency in `pkg/scheduler`. The only usage was that of a const `NoteLengthLimit`. Part of #141411 which requires there be no `k8s.io/kubernetes` dependencies from `pkg/scheduler`.

nodes.body: LGTM! Code changes are clean and well-structured.
Please mention where the original is defined
Should we also mention that in the validation pkg, so if you ever change that value, you should change the scheduler's const too?

> Should we also mention that in the validation pkg, so if you ever change that value, you should change the scheduler's const too?

We could enforce the equality of the two constants with a unit test under `pkg/apis/core/validation`. I'm slightly hesitant to recommend it since it would mean scheduler owners copying the constant adds friction on api owners. But maybe it's worth it.

If unit tests are introduced under `pkg/apis/core/validation` then wouldn't that mean `core/validation`'s tests would need to import `k8s.io/kube-scheduler` (after the move). It seems counterintuitive to me to give a core API validation package a dependency on a component?

I am unsure if this is a suitable solution, but could we potentially migrate this, and other values with similar issues, to a third external package of some description, if one exists? Thus allowing both sides to import.

In the meantime I will add where the original is defined in comment.
updated comment @brejman

Can't we move the const definition from `pkg/apis/core/validation` to `staging/k8s.io/component-helpers/scheduling/corev1`? Validation already imports that package, so I don't think it would be breaking any contracts, and at the same time it will ensure the limit is consistent

IMO the constant is too general to be in a scheduling directory

nodes.title: Remove dependency to k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/apis/core/validation
nodes.body:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/141403 needs to be merged first

Only dependency for scheduler is ```NoteLengthLimit```, we can create our own const, if value for this will change it will increase, so we should be safe with having our own const for this. Or we can check if there is a good place in staging to put it for general use.

Any ```k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/apis/core/validation``` entry in the allow-list added by https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/141415 should be removed in the same PR.
 
/sig scheduling

This issue is currently awaiting triage.

If a SIG or subproject determines this is a relevant issue, they will accept it by applying the `triage/accepted` label and provide further guidance.

The `triage/accepted` label can be added by org members by writing `/triage accepted` in a comment.


<details>

Instructions for interacting with me using PR comments are available [here](https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/guide/pull-requests.md).  If you have questions or suggestions related to my behavior, please file an issue against the [kubernetes-sigs/prow](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/prow/issues/new?title=Prow%20issue:) repository.
</details>

@antekjb I'd like to pick this up after #141415 merges, if it's available. 

From my understanding this and others in #141411 are related, but depend on #141403? I learned about these issues from @macsko following the last SIG scheduling meeting (thank you). This would be my first contribution to k/k so any advice and adjustments would be welcomed :)

Confirming the scope: `NoteLengthLimit` is the only symbol `pkg/scheduler` uses from `k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/apis/core/validation`. `validation.NoteLengthLimit` is referenced exactly once, inside `truncateMessage` in `pkg/scheduler/schedule_one.go`. That function has one production caller and two in `schedule_one_test.go`.

It's defined as `NoteLengthLimit = 1024` in`pkg/apis/core/validation/events.go`, and the scheduler and that file are its only two users in the whole repo.

On the comments in the issue description: I couldn't find an obvious existing location suitable for it in staging. `component-helpers/scheduling` exists, but the constant is an Events API validation limit rather than a scheduling concept, so putting it there doesn't seem right.

I think it would be reasonable to have it as a local const in `pkg/scheduler`, with a comment recording that a local copy is safe since the value can only grow.

Thanks in advance and appreciate patience while I'm still learning.

> From my understanding this and others in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/141411 are related, but depend on https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/141403?

That's right

> I think it would be reasonable to have it as a local const in pkg/scheduler, with a comment recording that a local copy is safe since the value can only grow.

Sounds good!

Once you remove the dependency, you'll also need to remove it from the allow-list (added in #141415).

Note that PRs will need to wait a bit before they're merged because we are currently in code freeze.

Thanks very much :)

Understood on the allow-list removal. Will get both changes prepared and hold it until the freeze lifts - any advice on monitoring the progress?

/assign
